free_design.Place: A sunlit attic laundry room with a hand-operated wooden drying rack and a basket of clean folded linen.
free_design.Activity: She raises a small folded quilt onto the top drying rail; the reaching motion gently lifts the scalloped hem of her top, revealing her waist while the opaque cups and bottoms remain secure.
free_design.Pose: Kneeling upright on a padded low bench beside the rack, torso three-quarter to viewer, both arms raised naturally at different heights to support opposite ends of the quilt, looking toward the rail with a soft concentrated smile.
free_design.Framing: Three-quarter body view from a natural chest-height angle; her face and both arms visible, laundry work is the clear story.
free_design.Outfit: A plum-coloured opaque lingerie-inspired camisole with overlapping petal-shaped satin panels, a supportive sweetheart neckline and broad double shoulder bands, with matching flared tulip-cut tap shorts and a narrow gathered waist; no robe, corset, armor or faction colours.
